title: Parametric Session States Recover Retrieval Intent without Replaying History
abstract: arXiv:2610.33047v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-running assistants often interpret follow-up requests whose referents, constraints, and active goals were established many turns earlier. The central challenge is therefore not only context length, but retrieval intent: a current query such as ``use the previous configuration'' may omit the project, entity, and version terms needed to locate relevant evidence. Long-context models can recover those terms by replaying the interaction, but repeatedly pay the cost of processing history. Conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is cheaper, yet assumes an information-sufficient query; conversational rewriting either rereads the history or depends on an explicitly maintained textual memory. We introduce \emph{Parametric Session State} (\method{}), a reusable session-memory layer that remembers what to search for while keeping factual knowledge external.

translated_title: 参数化会话状态：无需重放历史即可恢复检索意图
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.33047v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：长期运行的助手常常需要解释这样的后续请求：其指代对象、约束条件和当前目标早在许多轮对话之前就已确立。因此，核心挑战不仅在于上下文长度，更在于检索意图：诸如“使用之前的配置”这样的当前查询可能省略了定位相关证据所需的项目、实体和版本等术语。长上下文模型可以通过重放交互历史来恢复这些术语，但需要反复承担处理历史记录的成本。传统的检索增强生成（RAG）虽然成本更低，但其假设查询本身包含足够的信息；对话式改写方法要么需要重新阅读历史记录，要么依赖于显式维护的文本记忆。我们提出了参数化会话状态（Parametric Session State），这是一个可复用的会话记忆层，它能够记住要搜索什么，同时将事实知识保持在外部。
tldr: 提出参数化会话状态方法，通过可复用的会话记忆层记住检索意图，使长期对话助手无需重放历史记录即可解析缺乏关键检索词的后续请求，同时保持事实知识外置。
en_tdlr: Introducing Parametric Session State, a reusable session-memory layer that remembers what to search for, enabling long-running assistants to recover retrieval intent from underspecified follow-up queries without replaying conversation history while keeping factual knowledge external.
